title: Business Development Executive
description:
This position has now been filled. If you are interested in this type of vacancy moving forward, please do send your CV across for the future

R13 are currently recruiting for a Business Development Executive to join a growing sales team, playing an important role in converting warm, inbound interest into genuine sales opportunities. With this position, there s no cold calling involved. You ll be working with warm leads from B2 B clients who have actively expressed an interest, whether through a website enquiry, marketing activity or previous engagement with the business.

This role has been created as a development route into a more senior consultative sales position, giving you the opportunity to build your product knowledge, develop your sales skills and learn the business before progressing into a full specialist Business Development role. It s designed to be an opportunity for someone who has the right sales ability but may not yet have the depth of the company s specialist product knowledge needed to step straight into a senior-level position.

Salary is offered at £26,750 with realistic OTE of £45,000 at this starting-level position OTE increasing significantly as you progress into the more senior role. Monday-Friday 9-5 hours, based in central Norwich offices.

The Company

Our client is a well-established and growing specialist business with a strong reputation in its market. The sales team is continuing to develop, with a real focus on bringing ambitious sales people into the business and giving them the training and support to build a successful career.

You ll be joining a collaborative sales environment where the team work closely together, share knowledge and support one another to convert inbound opportunities into new business.

Benefits
- Clear progression route into a specialist sales role with increased OTE.
- Office-based during probation, with up to 2 days working from home thereafter.
- 25 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays.
- Additional day off for your birthday.
- Bupa healthcare plan.
- Statutory pension.
- Free parking (limited spaces)
- Central city based location
- Supportive, collaborative sales environment.
- Structured training and ongoing product development.

The Day-to-Day
- Manage a portfolio of warm, inbound enquiries, ensuring potential customers receive a great first impression.
- Speak with prospective clients to understand their requirements, motivations, timescales and what they are looking to achieve.
- Ask the right questions to qualify opportunities and establish whether the business can provide the right solution.
- Build rapport quickly and have confident, consultative conversations with prospective customers.
- Schedule qualified appointments with the senior members of the team.
- Work towards agreed targets around lead qualification, appointments booked and appointments attended.
- Maintain accurate CRM records, including lead information, qualification notes and appointment outcomes.
- Follow up with prospects where appropriate and keep opportunities moving through the early stages of the sales process.
- Build your product and industry knowledge through structured training, hands-on experience and working alongside experienced salespeople.

You Will Have / Be
- Previous experience in sales, business development, appointment setting or lead qualification role.
- Confident communication skills and the ability to build rapport quickly.
- Comfortable asking questions, listening properly and getting to the heart of what a business actually needs.
- Commercially minded, with a genuine interest in developing your sales ability.
- Target-driven and motivated by achieving results.
- Organised and confident managing a busy pipeline of enquiries.
- Resilient and able to handle a high volume of conversations without losing quality.
- Naturally curious and keen to build your knowledge of a new product and industry.
- Ambitious, with an interest in progressing into a more senior consultative sales position.

How to Apply

To hear more details about this fantastic opportunity, please email your CV to Rebecca Headden Business Partner at R13 Recruitment. If you don't hear from us within 5 working days of submitting your application, please assume you have been unsuccessful on this occasion.

For candidates applying from outside the local region, please include a brief covering note outlining your relocation plans, current location, and anticipated timeframe for moving. Applications without this information may not be considered further.

title: Charity Membership Sales Representative

description:
Charity Membership Sales Representative £20+ Per Hour OTE Uncapped Commission

Realistic earnings: £20+ per hour, including commission
Top performers: £30 £40 per hour
Hours: Part-time Friday to Sunday (3 days per week, consideration give to more days)
Location: Norfolk Norwich, King's Lynn, Great Yarmouth, Dereham, Fakenham and surrounding areas

Earn great money. Meet great people. Make a difference.

Are you confident, outgoing and enjoy talking to people?

Would you like to earn £20+ per hour while helping protect Norfolk's wildlife?

CF Fundraising Ltd is recruiting enthusiastic Charity Membership Fundraisers to represent Norfolk Wildlife Trust at busy shopping centres, garden centres, country shows and events across Norfolk.

Our fundraisers realistically earn £20+ per hour, including commission, with some of our top performers achieving £30 £40 per hour.

You'll receive a guaranteed hourly wage, with additional uncapped commission the more successful you are, the more you can earn.

No previous fundraising experience is necessary. If you're a natural communicator, enjoy meeting new people and are motivated by achieving results, we'll provide all the training and support you need.

What's involved?

You'll be the face of Norfolk Wildlife Trust, engaging with members of the public, sharing the Trust's conservation work and encouraging people to become regular members.

Working at pre-booked venues and events, you'll:
- Approach members of the public and start friendly conversations.
- Explain how membership helps protect Norfolk's wildlife and natural habitats.
- Inspire people to become supporters of the Trust.
- Work towards individual and team membership targets.
- Deliver a positive, professional experience.

Every membership you secure helps support wildlife conservation across Norfolk.

What we're looking for

We're interested in people with the confidence and personality to engage with the public.

Previous experience in sales, fundraising, retail, hospitality, customer service, recruitment or promotions would be useful, but is not essential.

You'll need to be:
- Friendly, confident and approachable.
- Positive, motivated and comfortable working towards targets.
- A good communicator who enjoys meeting new people.
- Reliable, professional and well presented.
- Available to work Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
- A full UK driving licence holder with access to your own vehicle.

What we offer
- Realistic earnings of £20+ per hour including commission.
- Uncapped commission, with top performers earning £30 £40 per hour.
- Guaranteed hourly pay with a National Living Wage guarantee.
- Comprehensive training and ongoing support.
- Six weeks' annual leave pro rata, including bank holidays.
- Contribution towards travel expenses.
- Accommodation provided when overnight stays are required.
- Uniform, tablet and all equipment supplied.
- A friendly, supportive and rewarding working environment.

Why Norfolk Wildlife Trust?

Norfolk Wildlife Trust is the county's largest environmental charity and the oldest Wildlife Trust in the UK.

Managing more than 60 nature reserves across Norfolk, the Trust works tirelessly to protect wildlife, restore habitats and create a wilder future for generations to come.

This is more than a sales job. Every membership you secure helps protect the wildlife and wild places that make Norfolk special.

Interested?

If you enjoy meeting people, are motivated by earning potential and want to do something genuinely worthwhile, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today!

Send your CV to Jo Hill

CF Fundraising Ltd is an equal opportunities employer working on behalf of Norfolk Wildlife Trust. All applications will be processed in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.
